requiredInputs.authorityGeneration: Registry generation hash from compiled agent-runtime slices
requiredInputs.machine: Machine role/id from peer-live-proof + Office Admin + registry/machines/manifest.v1.json
requiredInputs.client: Agent client surface (cursor | claude | other) from registry
requiredInputs.profile: Workstation profile flags after baseline (controller, gpuExecutor, etc.)
requiredInputs.requiredCapabilities: Capability ids requested for the operation context
requiredInputs.mcpContracts: Required MCP bindings and contract generation from registry mcps manifest
requiredInputs.observations: Harvested machine-local realization observations (hooks, settings, paths, MCP wiring)

requiredOutputs.authorityGeneration: Generation hash echoed for convergence identity
requiredOutputs.profileResolution: Profile flags applied after baseline check
requiredOutputs.drift: Evaluated drift codes with severity (vocabulary from Cross-Agent only)
requiredOutputs.laneVerdict: Lane-level RESOLVED | HOLD | UNAVAILABLE — consumed by authority convergence
